integrity: Mathematical proof and independently runnable exact-rational checks are included; prior theorems on stability and eigenvalue expansion are credited; no independent review or certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Linear one-dimensional D1Q3 advection; 0<|c|<1; 0<s_v,s_w<2. The damping cap bounds zero-frequency collision factors, not the full Fourier ghost spectrum or solution error. The universal 1/8 limit is unattained. Historical priority needs independent assessment, including unavailable full text of a 2008 related advection-diffusion study.
title: Sharp dispersion versus kinetic-damping frontier for three-velocity lattice Boltzmann advection
